attempts.prompt:
USE: A commercial pharmaceutical packaging design mockup for review, fully redrawn as a photorealistic packshot. Do not claim it is an existing verified product photograph.

INPUTS: Image 1 is exact front artwork for Valbitrin 100 option C1. Image 2 is the narrow side artwork. Use those images only as design and EXACT typographic references. Recreate the entire carton, print, perspective and product scene consistently; do not produce pasted-flat image panels.

SCENE: Pure white seamless background, soft diffuse studio light and close gentle shadows. Product occupies 80–85 percent of frame width, fully in frame. Target 1536 × 1024 pixels. Crisp, coherent carton edges, no dotted construction seams or white gaps. No prop objects.

SUBJECT: One very thin, long pharmaceutical carton with proportions 125 mm wide × 55 mm high × 12 mm thick. Its thin edge must be visible in a coherent 3/4 angle. One and ONLY one front-facing aluminium–PVC blister containing EXACTLY FOURTEEN round white film-coated tablets, arranged precisely TWO ROWS OF SEVEN, lies in front-left. Do not create a second blister or loose tablets.

DESIGN: ivory upper face with a broad navy-to-red flowing lower wave, large navy product name, clearly separated dosage block and high-contrast small information on the lower band. Family palette is white/ivory, red #C62828 and blue #1E4E9A. Abstract curved lines or waves only, no red triangles, no square-grid brand motif, no person, organ or symptom. Vietnamese remains primary; smaller English is secondary. Preserve product geometry and label legibility exactly.

TYPE: The name is "Valbitrin" beside a RED rounded block "100". Preserve the two ingredient lines, especially decimal commas: "Mỗi viên nén bao phim chứa:" and "Sacubitril 48,6 mg + Valsartan 51,4 mg". Do not replace the commas by periods and do not interchange either number. Side shows only vertical "VALBITRIN 100".

EXACT CONTENT: All front text must match Image 1 EXACT, verbatim. The approved content is: "Valbitrin 100" | "Mỗi viên nén bao phim chứa: Sacubitril 48,6 mg + Valsartan 51,4 mg" | "Viên nén bao phim · Uống" | "Film-coated tablets · Oral use" | "Hộp 2 vỉ x 14 viên nén bao phim" | "Box of 2 blisters x 14 film-coated tablets" | "Cơ sở sản xuất: Công ty CP Dược phẩm Vĩnh Phúc (Vinphaco) – Việt Nam" | "Đọc kỹ hướng dẫn sử dụng trước khi dùng" | "Để xa tầm tay trẻ em" | "Chỉ định, chống chỉ định, cách dùng và các thông tin khác: xem tờ hướng dẫn sử dụng" | "Số lô SX:" | "NSX:" | "HD:". Keep every Vietnamese accent and unit. Line breaks may follow the reference. Standard instructions and blank "Số lô SX:" / "NSX:" / "HD:" appear in the lower front; never invent numbers or dates. No additional wording. Count the tablet cavities: exactly 7 in the first row and 7 in the second row. Flat unmarked white round tablets, no score lines or pill lettering.

MATERIAL: matte-laminated white ivory paperboard carton (~300 gsm), offset printed, crisp folded edges, no foil, no gloss UV, no specular highlights. aluminium–PVC blister shown FRONT SIDE ONLY (clear thermoformed PVC cavities with the tablets/capsules visible, plain silver aluminium base around them); perforation lines between cells. Do NOT show or create the back (foil) side; no second blister; no text on the blister.

CONSTRAINTS: No logo of any kind, no red triangle, no NNC, no ℞/Rx, no GMP, no registration number, no barcode, no watermark, no address, no extra claim. Matte natural carton finish. The model renders the complete photograph: no code overlays or SVG composites in the finished image.

results.count_qa: DAT: exactly 14 tablets, two rows of seven
results.geometry_qa: Long slim carton, front/right side/top visible; one front blister only
limits: Material and physical dimensions are visual approximations.

The only lettering on EVERY ampoule is "VINDEXA 8 mg/2 ml", printed directly in one colour; absolutely no smaller secondary characters. Side shows only vertical "VINDEXA 8 mg/2 ml".

EXACT CONTENT: All front text must match Image 1 EXACT, verbatim.
